title: Tiny, cute motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="84" rx="38" ry="6" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  
  <!-- rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="72" r="14" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="72" r="12" fill="#555577"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="72" r="6" fill="#8888aa"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="72" r="3" fill="#aaaacc"/>
  <!-- spokes -->
  <line x1="28" y1="60" x2="28" y2="84" stroke="#aaaacc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="72" x2="40" y2="72" stroke="#aaaacc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- front wheel -->
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="14" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="12" fill="#555577"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="6" fill="#8888aa"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="72" r="3" fill="#aaaacc"/>
  <!-- spokes -->
  <line x1="74" y1="60" x2="74" y2="84" stroke="#aaaacc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="72" x2="86" y2="72" stroke="#aaaacc" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- frame body -->
  <path d="M28 72 Q30 55 42 52 L60 52 Q70 52 74 64 L74 72" fill="none" stroke="#ff6688" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  
  <!-- seat -->
  <rect x="38" y="47" width="24" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ffaa44"/>
  
  <!-- fuel tank -->
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="52" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#ff6688"/>
  <ellipse cx="56" cy="50" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#ff8caa"/>
  
  <!-- handlebar stem -->
  <line x1="70" y1="52" x2="76" y2="42" stroke="#ff6688" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- handlebar -->
  <line x1="66" y1="40" x2="84" y2="40" stroke="#ffaa44" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- handlebar grips -->
  <circle cx="66" cy="40" r="3" fill="#44ddff"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="40" r="3" fill="#44ddff"/>
  
  <!-- headlight -->
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="5" fill="#ffee55"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="50" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  
  <!-- exhaust pipe -->
  <path d="M32 68 L26 74" stroke="#ccccdd" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- cute smiley face on tank -->
  <circle cx="53" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#ffee55"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="50" r="1.2" fill="#ffee55"/>
  <path d="M53 53 Q56 55 59 53" fill="none" stroke="#ffee55" stroke-width="1.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- kickstand -->
  <line x1="35" y1="72" x2="30" y2="82" stroke="#ccccdd" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
